svg.aria-label: Teaching model of recovery from ideal complete saturation. Two environments have T₁ of 1 s and 3 s and a true nucleus-count ratio of 3/2. Short repetition converts unequal recovery into integral-ratio bias. Equal excitation and detection efficiencies isolate why quantitative acquisition must consider recovery time.
